name: Video_SetModeX
note: INT10 13h then unchain: 320x240 mode X (480-line CRTC; offset 0x30 = 384 px virtual width); clears VRAM

name: Tiles_DrawColumnsParallax
note: tile plane over parallax buffer (tile 0x80 transparent)

name: Tiles_DrawColumns
note: 24x16 window of 16x16 tiles; one plane per call

name: Video_SetSplitLine
note: CRTC line compare (18h/07h/09h) = HUD split screen

name: Video_SetStartAndPan
note: (x;y;pageofs) CRTC 0Ch/0Dh + attr 33h pel pan; waits vsync

name: Kbd_ISR
note: INT 9 handler (code label): in 0x60; toggle 0x61; EOI; g_KeyDown[scan]; copies JS.CFG-mapped keys to slots 0x8453a-0x84564

name: Timer_Install
note: DPMI 0x205 INT 8 -> 0x310ba; PIT ch0 divisor 0x5d37 (~50 Hz)

name: FatalError
note: CD stop; sound shutdown; text mode; printf %s%s; exit

name: Sprite_Queue
note: (x;y;id) add to draw list; ids > 0x8000 mirrored; wrap at 384

name: Sprites_LoadSpx
note: data/jetstrike.spx -> g_SpriteTab (8-byte hdr x;y;w/4;h); on reload only data/jetsprit.pal colours 64-95

name: Pic_LoadPax
note: (name;page;applyPal): gfx/<name> LZW -> page (320x200 at row 20); gfx/<name>.pal 64 colours

name: Sprites_ReplaceFromBank
note: (slot;n;bank) copy n-th sprite of a bank into slot

name: Pic_LoadHudPanel
note: gfx/display.pax to VRAM top + .pal; split 0xaf; start 0x1ec0

name: Tileset_LoadTlx
note: map/<name>.tlx (LZW 256 tiles x 0x40) + map/<name>.pal (64 colours at index 128)

name: Parallax_Load
note: map/<name>.dx0|dx1 (LZW 0x28000 backdrop) + .p00/.p01/.p10 palette; detail off -> plain sky colours

name: Level_DrawBackground
note: 24x16 tile window at camera into back page; parallax/no-parallax per plane

name: Video_FlipPage
note: show back page (scroll + 0x600); g_VSyncWaits vsyncs; colour cycling; swap 0x18c0/0x78c0

name: Video_BenchmarkSpeed
note: tile draw speed vs vsync -> g_VSyncWaits 0/1/2

name: Joystick_ReadDirs
note: reads axes vs calibration -> dir bits; buttons

name: main
note: Watcom main(): 2.5MB check; alloc pack buffers; kbd ISR; load jetstrike.spx; read js.cfg; joystick init; set mode X; CPU bench; Game_Run; shutdown; credits

name: Bonus_Award
note: switch on bonus type: Extra Aircraft; Auto Eject ...

name: NameEntry_ReadString
note: text entry loop (key reader is a stub)

name: Game_Run
note: master loop: loads gendat3/gendat2/misc/misc.z; outer loop = MainMenu -> mission loop -> per-frame loop with object updaters -> debrief/end

name: Mission_Setup
note: per-mission: stop CD; briefing; plane/weapon select; load map .val/.mp2/.mxp; tileset; parallax; HUD panel; init player state

name: Mission_LoadBriefing
note: reads data/M<mode> record (0x1c2 bytes) for g_Mission: briefing text; map name; tileset name; 30 BE params; story .asc; data/enemies; jetlogo.pax briefing; 'Press f1 to f10 to save'

name: Story_ShowAsc
note: opens data/<name>.asc (picture name + text lines) and displays story screen

name: Map_LoadMxp
note: map/<name><NN>.mxp LZW -> g_MapGrid (BE width + width x 64); column height table

name: PlaneSelect_Screen
note: planech.pax plane choice (2 slots); Glider special case; calls WeaponSelect

name: Text_DrawCenteredAt
note: center small text in a box

name: SelectScreen_ShowPlaneName
note: prints jets.n name for plane index

name: Mission_Debrief
note: post-mission screen; loads sarcasm messages on first use

name: Player_Update
note: player plane control; flight; camera follow modes (weapon cam; B52; Fat Albert; camera pod)

name: CD_Check
note: 0 ok; 1 no MSCDEX; 2 old; 3 wrong CD (needs 15 tracks)

name: EndGame_Screen
note: game over: gamedone.pax / AeroScores / endgameN.pax with text; plays CD track N+7

name: Timer_ISR_SBMixer
note: INT 8 handler (code label): mixes 4 SFX channels into SB DMA ring buffer (0x80 = silence)

name: Sound_Init
note: GUS (obj4) else SB; loads misc/jetsound.aaf; DOS buffer; IRQ; DMA; timer

name: SaveGame_LoadMenu
note: 'Press F1 to F10 to load game': reads js_save.00N

name: Input_ReadControls
note: merges remapped keys + joystick into g_Ctrl[11] at 0x90c98; fire -> 0x8455c

name: MainMenu
note: first call: CD check (Wrong CD) + Sound_Init; loads jets.n weapons.dat hudtext.dat l1l2 gendatad.dax gendata.dax; menu on miscon.pax (zone map) sets g_GameMode

name: MainMenu_Draw
note: loads miscon.pax and registers menu hit zones

name: __cstart_body
note: startup continuation: INT21 30h DOS version; 4Ah resize; DGROUP/env setup; calls __InitRtns and __CMain

name: __fatal_runtime_error
note: writes message to CON (INT21 3Dh/40h) and terminates (INT21 4Ch)

name: __GETDS
note: loads DS from saved selector at cs:[0x48644]

name: outp
note: out dx;al - game uses for VGA DAC 0x3c8 and PIT 0x40/0x43

name: _dos_getvect
note: INT21 35h (2502h under Phar Lap); game: vector 9 (keyboard) and timer vector

name: _dos_setvect
note: INT21 25h (2504h Phar Lap); game installs keyboard ISR 0x10760 on INT 9 and ISR 0x31a31 on timer vector (DAT_93380)

name: int386
note: int386(intno;in;out) -> segread + int386x; game uses INT 31h (DPMI)

name: __doclose
note: close stream; free buffer; remove tmpfile

name: __shutdown_stream
note: flush; reposition; close handle; free buffer

name: outpw
note: out dx;ax - game: VGA seq/GC/CRTC regs 0x3c4/0x3ce/0x3d4

name: __FSA
note: float add (dispatch via [0x807f8]: x87 or emulated)

name: __init_float_dispatch
note: selects x87 or emulated float add/mul/div based on 8087 flag 0x80a59

name: __FSI4
note: float -> int32 (table of float->int entry points follows)

name: __CMain
note: sets up stack; calls main (0x000146f4) then exit

name: __InitRtns
note: runs XI init table by priority

name: __FiniRtns
note: runs YI fini table by priority

name: __LinkUpNewMHeap
note: inserts new heap segment into heap list

name: __LastFree
note: size of free block at end of DGROUP

name: __CreateNewNHeap
note: DPMI 0501h alloc / INT21 48h; DPMI 0006h get segment base

name: __ExpandDGROUP
note: grows near heap (sbrk / new DPMI block)

name: __purgefp
note: frees FILE free list at exit

name: __get_tmp_id
note: returns DAT_80814 (used for tmp file naming)

name: __flush
note: flush stream buffer (write or seek back)

name: frexp
note: FP helper used by trig and printf

name: __mul64_helper
note: 64-bit arithmetic helper for trig range reduction

name: __int386x_body
note: loads regs; executes INT via stub table

name: __int_table
note: table of 'int N' stubs for all 256 vectors

name: write
note: INT21 40h with text-mode LF->CRLF; append via 42h

name: __full_io_exit
note: closes all streams; frees FILE list

name: __qwrite
note: INT21 40h raw write (seek end for append)

name: __math_error
note: calls matherr; prints func: DOMAIN error to stderr

name: LZW_Unpack
note: obj2 asm (src;dst) LZW 9..12 bit; dict in BSS 0x60000; first dword = unpacked size

name: g_GameMode
note: 0 campaign M0; 1 training M1; 2 practice M2; 3 Aerolimits M3
